preconditions.description: a, b, and k are within the specified range.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'No' or 'Yes' followed by two binary numbers.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'No' or (return_value.split('\n')[1].count('0') == a and return_value.split('\n')[1].count('1') == b)
postconditions.description: The first binary number x has exactly a zeroes and b ones.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'No' or (return_value.split('\n')[2].count('0') == a and return_value.split('\n')[2].count('1') == b)
postconditions.description: The second binary number y has exactly a zeroes and b ones.
x is greater than or equal to y.
The binary representation of x - y has exactly k ones.
